reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Update to Kubernetes v1.34.0 and Go 1.25.0 by @stefanprodan in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5499", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: No operator-facing effect is described; the item is a dependency and toolchain update of Flux itself (built against Kubernetes v1.34.0 libraries and Go 1.25.0).

proposed.statement: Flux 2.7.0 updates its build to Kubernetes v1.34.0 libraries and Go 1.25.0, and the release note describes no operator-facing effect of this dependency/toolchain update.
